title: King Oliver's trombonist George Fields and trumpeter Bob Schaffner
summary: Bigard names the missing members of Oliver's band, George Fields and Bob Schaffner, who stayed in Chicago and had a lip pierced.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: And when we first talked about King Oliver, at the time you joined him there were two band members whose name but you couldn't remember them.
George Fields was one, the trombonist.
The trumpet player was Bob Schaffner.
You have something else you were going to say about Schaffner?
Yeah, I was going to say he was quite a musician, that guy. . He was -- I think he was originally from St. Louis and he migrated to Chicago, then he lived in Chicago.
How long was he with King Oliver, do you know?
Oh, quite a few -- couple of -- three years, I imagine.
Well, he didn't go on to New York,

with King Oliver, did he?
obviously

No, he didn't go on to New York with us. That's when he -- he had lip trouble and he had to have it pierced and he knew only about one doctor in St. Louis that could do the job. And after he had it pierced, then he couldn't play for quite a while till it healed properly.
